integrity: The analytic proof supports all integer sizes at least two; exact rational checks independently test sizes two through thirty only. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact null law for every integer \(m\ge2\) under Dirichlet concentration one; no alternative, nonlinear independence, or power claims. Literature comparison may have missed an equivalent general mixed ordered-Dirichlet moment identity.
title: Exact positive covariance of maximal and quadratic uniform spacings
